4 modules · 98 questions · 2 h 14 min + 10 min break · Score Gap Report
Brain & Mind Academy · Abhyas Practice Series · Mock DSAT Practice Paper 47++ (“++” College Board series)
Built to the College Board Digital SAT format: Reading and Writing 2 × 27 questions (32 min each), 10-minute break, Math 2 × 22 questions (35 min each), with the standard domain mix. Reading and Writing questions and explanations are from College Board’s SAT Practice Tests 4–11; Math questions and rationales are the Medium and Hard questions of the College Board SAT Suite Question Bank, shown as published. Questions recur across this 30-paper series but never within a paper. Topic tags and the Score Gap Report are by Brain & Mind Academy. SAT is a trademark of the College Board, which is not affiliated with Brain & Mind Academy.
